title: Firefox warning: your code will run very slowly
body:
The full warning is:

> mutating the [[Prototype]] of an object will cause your code to run very slowly; instead create the object with the correct initial [[Prototype]] value using Object.create

I can reproduce on Firefox on Linux and Mac OS X.

comments.body: Hi @JustinDrake thanks for reporting this issue. Do you find this error in the documentation or on a specific example? Or is it in your implementation? Either way can you give us the URL?
Sorry, this is an error displayed in the FireFox JavaScript console. My specific implementation is www.duosear.ch, but I believe the issue is not specific to my implementation.
Hi @JustinDrake I am not reproducing the error using Firefox stable. Wondering how I could reproduce it.
Simply browsing to www.duosear.ch on FireFox 47 was enough to show the warning in the JavaScript console. I'm now on FireFix 48 and the warning has gone. 👍
